checks.description: Project imports without an engine failure
Configured main scene runs
No candidate parse, script or resource loading errors
Live dashboard snapshots are available
Public dashboard shape and required numeric slots
Launch, choose Quick play | Show a menu, then the fixed two-side Plain and Simple match | Require custom setup or hidden actions | Menu changes to 3D battlefield
Start or restart | Each side starts with one completed Command Center, two Workers, one Drone; player has 10 blue and 10 red resources | Retain prior units/resources | Initial units and HUD

Enter match | Flat bounded ground 0–50 on both axes; friendly base (10,7), enemy base (40,43); blue/red deposits near each with reserves sufficient to build every structure/unit type | Block every route or change layout on restart | Ownership/minerals distinguishable; deposit arrangement is free

Left click friendly unit/building or empty ground | Select object and show health/context controls, or clear on empty ground | Control enemies | Selection marker
Drag; Shift-select | Rectangle selects friendly mobiles inside it; Shift adds/removes without clearing others | Select enemies or outside objects | Group markers

Worker right-clicks blue/red minerals | Travel, gather, return to completed friendly Command Center and credit the correct resource; repeat | Credit before deposit or duplicate delivery | Movement and HUD update
Source empty or no completed destination | Stop invalid gathering safely | Generate resources from nothing | Idle/unavailable state

Worker places valid affordable blueprint | Charge listed cost once, construct over visible nonzero duration, become usable on completion | Produce/fire while unfinished | Progress and completed appearance
Placement outside bounds, overlapping solids, or unaffordable | Reject without resource/object changes | Charge invalid placement | Invalid preview/reason
R or right click during preview | R rotates a quarter-turn; right click cancels without charge | Build on cancel | Rotated/removed preview

Selected building destroyed | Remove selection, controls, queues, minimap/fog presence; discard pending production without refund | Stale controls or post-destruction output | Other units remain controllable

Unit chosen at completed compatible producer | Charge once, append FIFO entry, max five including active; produce after listed simulation time | Unfinished/incompatible production or sixth entry | Ordered queue/progress
Click queued or blocked entry | Remove it and refund full cost once | Double refund or cancelled output | Queue/resources update

Completed first ground entry has no free output space | Wait at front with blocked label; after space clears spawn once without charge, then continue | Lose/overlap output or pass later entries ahead | Automatic unblock

Helicopter/Drone finishes | Spawn at flight altitude in free nearby in-bounds airspace; occupied airspace waits as PROD-03 | Aircraft overlap or remain stuck after clearing | Aircraft and queue update

Factory right-clicks ground/friendly unit | Set visible rally destination; new output moves there or toward living target | Move factory or change old unit commands | Destroyed target falls back to last valid position
Mobiles right-click terrain | Move toward destination inside bounds; ground avoids solids, aircraft flies above terrain | Teleport or ignore a new valid order | Travel then stop
Armed unit right-clicks supported visible enemy | Approach and attack with nonzero cadence; remove at zero HP | Damage friendly/unsupported targets | Attack, health and destruction
Unsupported target/unarmed unit ordered to attack | Reject without damage | Worker/Drone attack or ground weapon damages aircraft | Movement remains usable
Enemy enters completed turret range | Attack supported domain automatically | Fire unfinished or at unsupported targets | Distinct ground/air turret roles

Match progresses | Enemy may gather and build defenses; initial completed anti-ground turret covers its base approach | Produce offensive mobiles such as Tanks/Helicopters | Defensive construction/fire

Enemy economy left uninterrupted | Enemy Workers can advance and construct anti-ground defenses within range of friendly base, enabling defeat through ordinary play | Require debug controls to lose | Visible construction precedes damage; player can prevent it
Hold WASD, use wheel | Continuous pan, bounded zoom | Edge scroll or Q/E/middle-mouse rotation | Useful battlefield view
Ctrl+1–9 then 1–9 | Store selection and recall surviving members | Recall destroyed/enemy objects | Selection markers
Home, I, F1 | Focus friendly base, cycle idle Workers, toggle controls help respectively | Select destroyed Workers | Camera/selection/help update
Units explore | Hide enemies outside friendly vision; retain explored terrain; minimap shows currently visible enemy locations | Minimap reveals unseen enemies | Fog/minimap agree; radius is free
